summary: 27-year-old man suffered a broken leg after sliding 30 yards down a snowfield above Lost Lake; two rangers (one a medic) flew in by Grand Teton NP helicopter after a SPOT device activation, flew him out to an ambulance for Estes Park Medical Center
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-07-15): northeast section of park; alert came via International Emergency Response Coordination Center
